integration: Project profiles are in config/tech-news-digest; Python adapter is dailyreport/tech_digest.py.
local_patches: fetch-twitter.py / fetch-web.py: use TECH_NEWS_DIGEST_STATE_DIR for caches, including on Windows
fetch-twitter.py: preserve original post text and API payload; use documented X post.fields and poll expansions
fetch-github.py: preserve REST release body, published_at, tag_name, draft and prerelease flags for evidence checking; Atom remains review-only

fetch-rss.py: reject source dates without timezones, preserve original published fields, and bypass conditional cache when the requested reporting window expands or a legacy guessed-date cache is found
